evidence: Changes message handling in src/net_processing.cpp for INV messages and block-relay-only disconnect enforcement.
rationale: Enforces BIP 144 compliance by ignoring MSG_WITNESS_TX in INV messages and fixes ordering so connections with tx relay disabled properly disconnect peers sending invalid transaction announcements. Commit 2eefc296d4 notes BIP 144 specifies MSG_WITNESS_TX is 'only for use in getdata', and moving the protocol violation check ensures block-relay-only peers cannot bypass disconnection by using unexpected inv types.
